geometry_policy: Original geometry coordinates retained unchanged. No simplification, rounding, repair or dropping. Only unused fields/whitespace removed.

adopted_layers.title: Hydrogeological regions of Canada
adopted_layers.scope: National hydrogeological context, nine broad regional classes. Not a complete local-aquifer inventory or a quantitative groundwater resource/availability layer.
adopted_layers.output_crs: EPSG:4326 explicitly requested in export. Response omits a crs member; longitude/latitude coordinate ranges are consistent with that request.
adopted_layers.licence: Open Government Licence - Canada, explicitly stated by current GEO.ca metadata for this dataset.
adopted_layers.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
adopted_layers.legacy_export_read_me: gin-regions-read-me.txt retains GIN Crown copyright/original-source ownership wording; current dataset-specific GEO.ca licence is recorded separately.
limitations: First-order regional geological/permafrost classes only; no groundwater storage volume, extraction, recharge amount, scarcity, quality or sustainable-yield measurements.
Source PRIMARY_ names differ from modern metadata terminology; raw labels retained.
Seven source polygon parts have self-intersections, preserved unchanged. See topology-validation.json for indices/reasons/coordinates.
Legacy AREA and PERIMETER fields removed from prepared file; they are not new measurements derived from longitude/latitude geometry.

adopted_layers.title: Ground Water Aquifers — selected southwestern BC example
adopted_layers.scope: 149 mapped aquifers intersecting the selected southwestern BC query window; not national or full-provincial coverage.
adopted_layers.output_crs: EPSG:4326; explicitly returned in source GeoJSON crs member.
adopted_layers.selection: Whole polygons intersecting bbox, not clipped. Bbox is a query window, not a complete-survey footprint.
adopted_layers.mapping_year_definition: Year aquifer was initially mapped or last updated.
adopted_layers.licence: Open Government Licence - British Columbia; expressly specified by this catalogue record.
adopted_layers.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia.
adopted_layers.definition: Developed ground water aquifers that have been mapped. Boundaries are mainly interpretive, using geology, hydrology, topography, well records, reports, air photographs and geological maps.
limitations: Some boundaries stop at BC mapsheet borders because of data/resource constraints at mapping time. Blank areas are not evidence of absent groundwater.
Geological material/subtype is not groundwater abundance or availability.
Source PRODUCTIVITY is qualitative ability to transmit/yield groundwater; source DEMAND describes use level when mapped. Both omitted from prepared file to prevent quantity/withdrawal implications.
58 source NAME values are null; LOCATION/AQUIFER_ID provide label fallback.
An earlier independent ArcGIS count returned 146 for this bbox and 1176 for BC; actual downloaded WFS response contains149. Do not infer whole-BC count/completeness from selected WFS sample.

excluded_layer.title: Key aquifers of Canada
excluded_layer.reason: Legacy metadata Constraints field is blank, original-source ownership is retained in the GIN disclaimer, and lineage combines provincial/watershed/university sources. No explicit blanket reuse licence verified; excluded from recommended adoption.

recommended_display_policy.national_regions_invalid_parts: Keep seven unchanged source parts as outlines; exclude fill; disclose 原資料の形状不整合で塗り表示を除外.
recommended_display_policy.invalid_source_impact: Seven affected parts contain5954of114278vertices, including large Atlantic regional footprints; not merely tiny islands. Eight proper nonadjacent edge crossing pairs identified. No repaired areas or invented boundaries generated.
recommended_display_policy.bc_aquifers: All149parts individually valid; overlapping aquifers are not a planar-partition error.
